renewal_notice_days.quote: 11.2 Exercise. Each option shall be exercised, if at all, by written notice delivered to Landlord not less than 270 days prior to the then-current Expiration Date.

rentable_sf.quote: The Premises are stipulated to contain 5,400 rentable square feet.

security_deposit.quote: 5.1 Deposit. Concurrently with Tenant’s execution of this Lease, Tenant shall deposit with Landlord the sum of $32,400.00 as a security deposit for the faithful performance of Tenant’s obligations hereunder.

uncertain: Extension-period Base Rent (Section 11.3, page 7) is the greater of the final-month Base Rent and 95% of fair market rental rate as reasonably determined by the parties; the market-rate component is not stated and cannot be derived, so renewal-period rent was not computed.

Operating expense estimate of $9.75/RSF/yr is Landlord's current estimate only (Section 4.1); actual amounts are subject to annual reconciliation (4.6) and a 5% cumulative cap on Controllable Operating Expenses (4.5). The stated monthly installment of $4,387.50 equals $9.75 x 5,400 RSF / 12.
Section 11.1 grants 'one (1) option' but uses 'each' and 'each extension period' language; count recorded as 1 as stated.

Possible template inconsistencies for human review: Section 6.2 references health information privacy requirements and Section 8.1 requires professional liability coverage, both unusual for a coffee shop; the Tenant notice email domain (northbaypt.example) does not match Northbay Coffee's name. These do not affect the extracted terms.
